title: Immutable HTTP Request (Builder / Functional Options)
summary: Build a validated, immutable request object with a Builder (Java, Python) or Go functional options.
hints: Java: the private constructor takes the Builder and copies everything with `Map.copyOf`, so later builder calls can't leak into a built request.
Validate per-field rules (method, timeout) as soon as they're set. Validate cross-field rules (a GET can't have a body) in `build()`.
Normalise header names with `toLowerCase()` when storing, so `Content-Type` and `content-type` are the same header.
Go: make `Option` a `func(*Request) error` so options can reject bad values. `NewRequest` applies options in order and returns the first error.

Python: copy the headers into a new `dict` and wrap it in `types.MappingProxyType` for a read-only view. Expose fields as `@property`s with no setters, and `__slots__` stops new attributes being added.
